questions.question: ED ground-state energy per site of the 4x4 Heisenberg AFM (J2 = 0)?
Same at the maximally frustrated point J2 = 0.5?
Exact energy per site of the Gutzwiller-projected pi-flux state on 4x4 (antiperiodic spinon BCs)?
questions.explanation: Its overlap with the true ground state is 0.85.

questions.question: Why does an RBM need the Marshall sign on the square lattice but struggles on kagome?
options: The bipartite AFM ground state has a known sign rule; frustrated lattices do not
questions.explanation: Marshall: sign = (-1)^(number of down spins on sublattice A). No such rule exists for frustrated magnets.
